# Selected original BigDusty investigation-map image blocks

Preserved for source-first inspection of early `INSIDE` in-game text. These are **unaltered bytes** from an independently maintained community visualization, not original 2016 Unity texture bytes, a full 2016 frame capture, or a newly solved ARG clue.

Upstream: https://github.com/sashaok123/BigDusty_INSIDE_ARG_Map
Upstream ref at retrieval: `main`
Retrieved: 2026-10-09
Upstream artwork and authorship remain with their original creators and contributors. BigDusty's map is attributed to the Playdead Unofficial community, concept April 2026.

| File | Upstream git blob SHA, identical after local Git import | Visible subject |
|---|---|---|
| [block_004.webp](block_004.webp) | `b82846b2209c36176c36461aba508430086df63f` | Two dark in-game images captioned A10N7, L08 by the map author |
| [block_009.webp](block_009.webp) | `7a425c2daa9a0d1a06b0f1d950543cb7d0ea7c16` | Lab-window / pulse-shield text ending in B02 and a montage captioned “2014 Trailer” |

**Caution:** Map captions are community annotations; they cannot settle whether `0`/`O` or `1`/`I` are differentiated in the original game font. The B02 “2014 Trailer” dating is a target for independent verification, not a date verified by these derived bytes.

See [bounded Wow! signal experiment](../../../../../docs/conjecture-lab/2026-10-09-wow-signal-environmental-inscriptions.md) and [reproducible checks](../../../../../scripts/audit_wow_signal_inscriptions.py). The analysis explicitly rejects treating matched-class rise/fall after 0/O substitution as independent statistical evidence (26/26 control).
